verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a first-party PII redaction feature that automatically detects and removes sensitive information from transcripts and audio recordings in its observability data. The evidence does not show that redaction happens before data is stored, and it shows no developer controls over what gets masked or how. Missing for 10: evidence that redaction runs pre-storage (or client-side in the tracing SDK), configurable or custom masking rules and entity types, coverage of trace metadata and tool payloads beyond transcripts and audio, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces

citations.quote: PII redaction automatically detects and removes sensitive information from both transcripts and audio recordings.
